# Third-party component

Mediabunny 1.61.0 by Vanilagy, MPL-2.0.

- `mediabunny-1.61.0.mjs` is an unmodified copy of the official npm package's `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs`.
- `Mediabunny-LICENSE.txt` contains the license.
- `mediabunny-1.61.0-source.tgz` contains the exact official npm package including TypeScript source, to provide the corresponding source with this distribution.
- Original package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.0.tgz
- Project: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny

Used only for optional preview-page MP4 export. It is not loaded or injected into the official Codex window. No install scripts were executed. The launcher's original code is separate from this component.
